data.name: Meherbano
data.gender_notes: Meherbano is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Meherbano is a beautiful Persian name derived from the words 'Meher' (the Generous One) and 'Bano' (Lady). It is a name of great respect and admiration, reflecting the qualities of kindness, generosity, and love. In Islamic culture, the name is believed to symbolize the compassionate and nurturing nature of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) wives, who were known for their generosity and care for their communities.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with love, kindness, and generosity.
data.etymology: Meherbano belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the Generous One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meherbano total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Meherbano
in_english.long_meaning: The name Meherbano is derived from the name of the wife of Merad bin Abi Sümeyy's son. The name means beloved, beloved, beloved and lovely. Parents who choose this name for their daughter want her to be beloved, beloved and lovely. They want to promote their daughter's beauty, love and loveliness.
